product_one_liner.value: Vim embeds payer and partner intelligence, care-gap insights, and applications into healthcare providers’ EHR workflows to support providers, payers, and health-tech developers.
product_one_liner.notes: Vim’s official homepage and press kit describe its in-workflow EHR platform, connecting healthcare participants and embedding payer intelligence, care-gap tools, and applications at the point of care. The sentence condenses those claims and names the served ecosystem.

pricing_page.notes: Vim has a public Vim Canvas pricing page that describes usage-based pricing options, so the answer is true even though it invites users to explore pricing rather than displaying all amounts.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Vim’s case studies identify Humana and MyCare Medical as organizations partnering with and using Vim’s products. | named_customers.0: The case study states that Humana partnered with Vim to digitize data exchange and capture. | named_customers.1: The case study names MyCare Medical and describes its deployment of Vim technology.

employee_band.notes: The press kit reports 132 employees, which falls within the 101-200 band.

founded_year.notes: The official press kit identifies Vim’s founded year as 2015.

eng_blog.notes: The Vim Engineering publication identifies backend and security topics and names its editors. Its indexed posts include a technical article on scalable TypeScript types used at Vim and an article by Yuval Peled on safer Bash scripting with Node.js; taken together these establish multiple technical engineering posts.

public_docs.notes: The public Vim Docs navigation links to platform documentation, how-to guides, VimOS JS, and an API, demonstrating a multi-article developer documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Vim’s live Greenhouse job posting is titled AI Ops Engineer and includes an Apply control, meeting the AI-role criterion.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest dated funding deal shown is July 1, 2021, far earlier than the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025, so the company did not raise in that window.
